draw: census: all 95 witnesses of census.json, in order
transcript: The proposal artifact is canonically serialised as JSON with recursive sorted keys and no whitespace, and those exact bytes are persisted as proposal_canon.json; a third party can re-derive hProposal by running sha256sum over proposal_canon.json, confirming it equals d9dc7a234b213ce4fdf5295fcd2bb6f9af2326bfd51e167d149bde5e0a496b5e, and can then re-derive the final seed by computing sha256(hProposal + salt) where salt = 8c2bb4701b66f06b2fa5077499c862176371718d15c9512b1957f2dd9d283839, reproducing seedHex = 2e9f21feb4adcb5ebb0a4539ce25919a7ccd41c6a36392b83bf17da12dea2ce2 exactly; the draw rule for this census mode is deterministic and requires no further sampling, since all N=95 witnesses of census.json are drawn in their existing order, so the seed serves only to bind this proposal artifact to the fixed witness bank rather than to select a subset.
